summary: The candidate proves the stated third-moment bound for the original closed-halfspace depth with the specified absolute constants. The quartic generating function and all moment estimates are valid; the new optimizer handles tied rates, inactive and zero multipliers, and deterministic coordinates; the shared-selection and slab predecessor facts are applied with their exact meanings and normalizations. Decreasing-event association, the additional original-score slab, conditioning of the correct dual score, the original Z^4 denominator, all coordinate factors, and the large- and small-n constant comparisons are correct. No mathematical errors or gaps were found, including in the zero-capacity and lower-dimensional cases.
